purpose: Define how the reusable surface-grid stack, confirmed resize recovery, Island v3 semantic engine, migration transformer, and downstream payload builders attach to the shared editor shell after P0 promotion without creating a second lifecycle, persistence path, or profile identity system.

controllerConstruction.compatibilityContextSource: active Island composition stability and override controls
controllerConstruction.profileChangeDestination: active editor envelope data map block
controllerConstruction.resizePreviewDestination: surface resize preview panel and optional adapter callback
controllerConstruction.resizeRecoveryDestination: controller lastResizeRecovery state until canonical save or explicit clear

sharedLifecycleRules.event: surface model cell change erase move or confirmed resize
sharedLifecycleRules.action: write controller map into the active Island profile and call KaysenderEditorLifecycle.markDirty exactly once
sharedLifecycleRules.autosave: use the existing shared lifecycle recovery autosave delay and callback

sharedLifecycleRules.action: calculate removed cells direct ledger references and dependent ledger references without changing the model or active profile
sharedLifecycleRules.autosave: do not mark dirty and do not schedule autosave
the resulting model event performs the single dirty mark and autosave scheduling
do not mark the Island profile dirty until a brush changes a cell

sharedLifecycleRules.event: cell selection or keyboard focus movement
sharedLifecycleRules.autosave: do not mark the Island profile dirty

canonicalBuildPipeline: build or update all quantitative ledgers
call KaysenderIslandV3Domain.applyDerived on the complete profile
return one canonical Island domain profile to the shared envelope builder
validationPipeline: run the Island 3.0.0 JSON schema validator
run downstream consumer reference and visibility checks
deduplicate diagnostics by severity code path and referenceId
render all results through the shared diagnostics surface
block canonical save or export on errors while allowing recovery autosave

open: render the existing Island form and production panels
create toolbar grid inspector and resize mount points
construct one IslandSurfaceGridController from the active profile
buildProfile: never preserve stale derived flags from an earlier revision
never export view-only selected brush selected cell resize preview or active flags
applyProfileToForm: apply non-map fields through the existing field mapping
call controller.replaceProfile with the imported migrated or recovered profile
clear prior resize recovery because it belongs to the replaced profile
preserve the nearest valid selected coordinate
validate: include broken nested IDs in recalculated derived.brokenReferenceIds
include warning diagnostics in recalculated derived.warnings
newBlankRecord: clear the prior active envelope and recovery draft through the shared runtime
construct a blank Island 3.0.0 profile with a default inactive grid envelope
replace the controller profile without retaining old linked IDs or resize recovery
recoverDraft: normalize and migrate the recovered envelope through the shared kernel
apply the recovered profile to the form and controller
preserve recovered stable cell IDs and references
restore resize recovery metadata when it is present in the recovery draft
recalculate derived data before canonical save
importRecord: normalize the imported envelope through the shared kernel
run the registered pure 2.0.0 to 3.0.0 transformer when required
reject future or unsupported schema versions
apply the imported profile to the form and controller
show provisional migration warnings without treating placeholder zeros as confirmed negative findings
randomizeUnlocked: operate only on selected blank or explicitly targeted cells and ledgers
skip brush field families whose target paths are locked
never regenerate the entire map because one field changed
exportCanonicalJson: flush controller.getMap into the active profile
recalculate derived data and downstream exports
exclude resize preview and recovery metadata from canonical domain data
cloneRecord: clone the shared envelope identity through the existing kernel
retain nested cell and entity IDs inside the cloned domain record unless collision policy requires deterministic remapping
do not clone transient resize recovery
close: destroy resize inspector toolbar and view subscriptions
retain the active envelope and recovery draft through existing runtime behavior

migrationRegistration.registrationTiming: only after P0 promotion and P1 activation
migrationRegistration.idempotenceRequirement: repeated transformation of the same source data produces identical migrated domain data crosswalks and migration log

downstreamExports.visibilityRule: standard consumer payloads exclude GM-only source IDs and gmSecrets text

lockSemantics.rule: A field lock blocks only brushes or inspector controls that would change that field. A child field lock does not automatically block unrelated cell fields.

resizePolicy.implementation: KaysenderSurfaceGridResize and IslandSurfaceGridController previewResize applyResizePlan getResizeRecovery clearResizeRecovery
resizePolicy.stalePlanPolicy: reject a plan when dimensions cell IDs or cell coordinates changed after preview
resizePolicy.removedRecords: returned by SurfaceGridModel.resize and retained as lastResizeRecovery until canonical save explicit clear or profile replacement
resizePolicy.directReferenceCheck: report water sources reservoirs resource nodes fault zones landing zones sites hazards habitats settlement slots and route nodes whose spatial fields reference removed cells
resizePolicy.dependentReferenceCheck: report settlement and route landing dependencies settlement water dependencies fracture-event fault dependencies approach-corridor landing dependencies and species-slot habitat dependencies
resizePolicy.outgoingCellLinks: retain removed cell water site resource and hazard IDs in the recovery snapshot
resizePolicy.cancelBehavior: leave dimensions records dirty state and recovery state unchanged
resizePolicy.canonicalExportBehavior: exclude transient preview and recovery state from the Island domain profile

activationGate: P0 integrated Island Settlement Airship browser receipt passes
P0 roadmap state is promoted to complete
Island 2.0.0 to 3.0.0 pure transformer is registered with the existing migration registry
Island built-in adapter current schema version is changed to 3.0.0
surface-grid resize domain and transformer files are added to the Island adapter load path
all P1 validators are added to the blocking workflow
valid migrated fractured and destructive-resize fixtures pass live Chromium interaction tests
